title: A directed family of subfields between K^p and K with intersection K^p detects differentials and p-th powers in finite extensions
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number, $K$ a field of characteristic $p$ and $K^p=\{a^p:a\in K\}$. Let $(K_\alpha)_{\alpha\in\mathcal A}$ be a family of subfields of $K$ such that (i) $K^p\subseteq K_\alpha$ for all $\alpha$; (ii) $K^p=\bigcap_{\alpha}K_\alpha$; (iii) for $\alpha,\alpha'\in\mathcal A$ there is $\alpha''\in\mathcal A$ with $K_{\alpha''}\subseteq K_\alpha\cap K_{\alpha'}$. Let $\Omega_{K/\mathbf F_p}$ and $\Omega_{K/K_\alpha}$ be the modules of Kähler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] and $\Omega_{K/\mathbf F_p}\to\Omega_{K/K_\alpha}$ the $K$-linear map with $\mathrm da\mapsto\mathrm da$ (it exists by the universal property, $\mathrm d:K\to\Omega_{K/K_\alpha}$ being in particular an $\mathbf F_p$-derivation). Then: (1) an element $\omega\in\Omega_{K/\mathbf F_p}$ whose image in $\Omega_{K/K_\alpha}$ is zero for every $\alpha\in\mathcal A$ is zero; (2) for every finite field extension $L/K$ [def-pc-field-extension] we have $L^p=\bigcap_{\alpha}L^pK_\alpha$, where $L^p=\{b^p:b\in L\}$ and $L^pK_\alpha$ is the subfield of $L$ generated by $L^p$ and $K_\alpha$.

split_report.summary: Checked against Stacks More on Algebra 07P4 (lemma-intersection-subfields, line 11458) and its proof, with 07P2 and 07P3; statement kept. Proof in 5 steps: a p-basis of K over F_p and the basis dx_i of Omega_{K/F_p} (existing nodes for 07P2 existence and (a)=>(b)); (1) by contradiction, the relations among the x^E forming a subspace V that meets every K_alpha^N by 07P2 (1)=>(2) for K/K_alpha (new node) and hence (K^p)^N by 07P3 (new node, with the nonempty index set made explicit and derived here from omega != 0); (2) by induction on [L:K] with the tower reduction of the source (tower law leaf), then the two cases theta^p not in K and theta^p in K (split this way instead of separable/inseparable, which avoids separability), each with L^pK_alpha identified and the intersection computed via a new Mathlib leaf for the power basis of a simple algebraic extension (Fields 09GN; IntermediateField.adjoin.powerBasis). Source error: in the case theta^p = t in K the source writes L^pK_alpha = sum_j K_alpha t^j as a direct sum, which fails when t is in K_alpha (K = F_p(s,u), K_1 = K^p(s), t = s: L^pK_1 = K_1 has degree p over K^p, not p^2); the conclusion holds by an argument using (iii), written out. 3 new nodes (2 unsplit, 1 Mathlib leaf).

lean.statement: theorem intersection_subfields_differentials (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharP K p] {ι : Type v} (Kα : ι → IntermediateField (ZMod p) K) (h₁ : ∀ α : ι, Set.range (fun x : K => x ^ p) ⊆ (Kα α : Set K)) (h₂ : Set.range (fun x : K => x ^ p) = ((⨅ α, Kα α : IntermediateField (ZMod p) K) : Set K)) (h₃ : ∀ α β : ι, ∃ γ : ι, Kα γ ≤ Kα α ⊓ Kα β) : (∀ ω : Ω[K⁄ZMod p], (∀ α : ι, KaehlerDifferential.map (ZMod p) (Kα α) K K ω = 0) → ω = 0) ∧ (∀ (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L], Set.range (fun x : L => x ^ p) = ⋂ α : ι, ((Subfield.closure (Set.range (fun x : L => x ^ p) ∪ (algebraMap K L '' (Kα α : Set K))) : Set L)))
